title: periods.billing_days
description: Dates within a range on which a subscription's billing period rolls over (BE-SP-30..33). Only the billing-day predicate of BE-SP-30..32 is evaluated, on the customer-local date (in `timezone`) of each run instant; the periodic selection of BE-SP-34 (status, start and creation dates, ending_at, earlier periodic invoices) is not applied (op periods.periodic_billing covers it).

timezone.description: Effective time zone of the customer (BE-DM-10).

from_date.description: First date of the range (local in `timezone`, or UTC when utc_hour is given).

to_date.description: Last date of the range (inclusive; at most 800 days after from_date).

utc_hour.description: null: one run at local noon of every local date of the range; the output lists those local dates. Otherwise one run per UTC date of the range at HH:10 UTC; the predicate is evaluated on the local date (in `timezone`) of that run instant, and the output lists the UTC dates of the runs that bill.
